method: One download-range request per frozen manifest series for 2026-06-03:2026-08-31, UTC day labels. Each answer is checked for the package name and the requested bounds and must list each of the 90 days exactly once with a nonnegative integer count; nothing is zero-filled. The answers were acquired after 2026-08-31 and list it explicitly. Days 2025-09-01 to 2026-06-02 are the frozen selection context, unchanged and not re-requested.
